sources.snippet: What is YuE-s1-7B-anneal-en-icl? YuE (pronounced as "yeah") is a groundbreaking open-source foundation model specifically designed for music generation, with the capability to transform lyrics into complete songs (lyrics2song). This particular variant focuses on English language processing with in-context learning capabilities.
